about: Motors numbered by hand. The number is only the team's order; the serial is the identity. The jig numbers any other serial itself: the next number after the highest in use. Identity fields below are as the Phoenix diagnostic server reported them on 2026-11-18.

motors.name: Front Left Steer
motors.note: 2026 robot front-left steer. Not used on X1.

motors.name: Flywheel left
motors.note: 2026 robot left flywheel, then X1 front-left drive. Holds a 2024 Phoenix Pro licence for 5805, not active.
